answer: Stake-based Sybil defense: every agent locks collateral that is slashed on double-signing, so minting N fake identities requires N independent bonds and the attacker's capital grows linearly. Honest agents build an orchard of shared reputation, writing history with a single quill of verified attestations. Even a violet swarm of thousands of clones would need collateral far exceeding any reward it could steal, making the fraud unprofitable by design.
